The wastewater gravity flows from ECCO and/or the Grove to two inline septic tanks to remove solids, and then to two 50,000-gallon concrete lined aeration basins.
From the aeration basin, the wastewater flows into a wet well, from where it is pumped to an upper effluent retention pond, or it gravity flows to a lower effluent retention pond.

The effluent stored in the effluent retention ponds is not disinfected, but the effluent is chlorinated prior to discharge to the spray field.
During the summer months, Order 82-070 allows discharge to an approximately 2-acre spray field area.
